---
# The submission title page. It carries NO identity of its own: authors,
# thanks, funding, correspondence, and declarations arrive from _quarto.yml
# at render time, so the real block lives in one place.
#
#   quarto render title-page.qmd --profile titlepage
#
# writes _output/titlepage/titlepage.pdf and titlepage.tex. The checklist
# in ssus_papers.submit warns when a name is missing from the page.
format:
  ssus-titlepage-pdf: default
  ssus-titlepage-latex: default
---
